title: S&P 500 Trailing P/E Ratio (As-Reported)
revision_note: Shiller periodically restates historical earnings figures, and interpolated months in the current quarter can shift slightly until the next quarter-end anchor lands. The site always shows the latest revision; the gh-pages deploy history is the vintage archive.
methodology: P/E = monthly average S&P 500 price / trailing 12-month as-reported (GAAP) EPS.

Historical months (1871 through Shiller's last confirmed quarter) use Shiller/Yale's own price and earnings: Shiller interpolates TTM earnings monthly between quarter-end anchors, so every interpolated month through that last anchor is treated as confirmed, matching his own construction.

The month after the last confirmed quarter, and the following two, hold TTM earnings flat at that quarter's value (estimated=true) paired with Shiller's own price where he already has it, else FRED's SP500 monthly average. Beyond that one-calendar-quarter grace window the series stops rather than forward-filling an increasingly stale earnings figure indefinitely.

The current, not-yet-completed month is never included: a partial month's average price changes daily (and Shiller's own row for it is a placeholder, e.g. a single day's close), while every other point in the series is a full-month figure.
notes: The dashed portion of the chart marks estimated months: the one-calendar-quarter grace window after the last confirmed quarter, described above.

Repointed 2026-09-16 (S9b) from the frozen Yale mirror of ie_data.xls to the actively maintained shillerdata.com copy, and from data/earnings_overrides.json (S&P Global's quarterly scorecard, discontinued by its publisher 31 Jan 2026) to Shiller's own earnings column, which reaches nearly as current and updates on its own; the overrides file is kept only as a cross-check, logged at fetch time. This also fixed a real bug: the old unlimited forward-fill had been overstating the P/E by roughly 26% by Aug 2026 (32.95× vs 26.1× on Shiller's own June 2026 earnings).

Not published on joemirza.com since 2026-09-15: the price and earnings behind this ratio are S&P Dow Jones Indices' data (reached here via Shiller and FRED rather than directly), and S&P declined free permission to display index values on a public site (case 01015670, 2026-09-15). Shiller's own terms are separately unknown (see catalog/sources/shiller.json). presentation.publish is false, so the generator leaves the page and data/sp500_pe.json out of the deployed site; scripts/dev.sh still builds it locally.

presentation.summary: Monthly S&P 500 trailing twelve-month P/E ratio, Shiller/Yale data back to 1871.
